headline: EDIT TRACK: the arcade's first draw-your-own course
lede: Excitebike's splash grew its second menu entry — design your own motocross from ramps, whoops, mud, water and boost, battery up to three into your phone, and ride them against the whole crash league at TRACK 7+.

notes.text: A course is data: your stamps compile into the same heightmap tables the shipped six ride, so the sim, the autopilot, WATCH and the rival pace lines never knew they were on a fan course. The audit that refuses an illegal save is the same law painting the cursor yellow or red while you draw.

305/305 excitecheck (compiler determinism, refusal-by-name, shipped-six byte pins, two saved drafts finished at wide-open throttle), 76/76 exciteplay in real keys and touch, flatten-a-ramp mutant reddens the geometry gate exactly once.
The design bay is phone-first: pad cursor to the EDIT row, tap opens it, A stamps whatever tool the strip points at. Digit 0 opens it on a keyboard; 1-3 battery a legal draft; Esc exits.

look.text: Design, save and ride a course of your own — press 0 at the splash
